title: Ungacela Kanjani I-Grant ye-SASSA
description: Uhlobo olugcwele lokucela noma iyiphi i-grant ye-SASSA yezenhlalo ngo-2026: iyiphi i-grant ehambelana nesimo sakho, yonke imibhalo ozoyidinga, ukuphi lapho uzocela, okwenzeka ngesikhathi sokuhlola imali, nesikhathi esithathwa ukunyuswa.

author.name: Lucky Cungwa
author.credentials: Verified against official SASSA publications and the Social Assistance Act

seo.metaTitle: Ungacela Kanjani I-Grant ye-SASSA — Umhlahlandlela Ngezinyathelo 2026
seo.metaDescription: Funda ukuthi ungacela kanjani i-grant ye-SASSA ngo-2026: khetha i-grant efanele, qoqa yonke imibhalo, dlula esivivinyweni semali, ufake esikhathini noma ku-inthanethi, landela isicelo sakho kuze kube yimvume.

contentBlocks.title: Ungacela Kanjani I-Grant ye-SASSA
contentBlocks.description: Ukucela i-grant yezenhlalo ye-SASSA kuyamahhala, futhi iningi lokwaliwa kungenxa yemibhalo engekho noma ukukhetha i-grant engalungile — hhayi ngoba awufaneleki. Lo mhlahlandlela uhola ekukhetheni i-grant efanele, ukuqoqweni kwemibhalo yonke, ukuthumeleni isicelo sakho, nasokulandeleni kube kukhokhelwa.

contentBlocks.text: Minyaka yonke izigidi zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika bacela izingodo zokusekela abantu, futhi ingxenye enkulu yesicelo ibambezeleka noma iyaliwa ngenxa yezinto ezivimbelayo: i-grant engalungile icingiwe, imibhalo embulala, noma ukuhlola imali kveze imali engasho. Lo mhlahlandlela ubalwa wonke umgudu wezingodo zihlala, ezifana nezingodo zabaDala, abaNgqabaza, nosizi lokunakekela, kanye nenqubo ku-inthanethi ye-SRD R370 grant.

Lo mhlahlandlela ukhona kulowo nalowo ozocela ngokwesibili, noma oxoxisa kabusha ngemuva kokuguquka kwezimo, noma onesiza ilungu lemhlophe ngalokhu kucela. Uma isicelo sakho sesaliwe funda umhlahlandlela wokukhala esikhundleni salo.

Ngaphambi kokuthatha imibhalo, qinisekisa ukuthi iyiphi i-grant ehambelana nesimo sakho. Ukucela i-grant engalungile kuchitha amasonto amaningi — isicelo sizohlolwa ngokwemigomo yaleyo grant bese iyaliwa uma ingafani. Sebenzisa lokhu kwethulwa kwezinhloko zezingodo namazinga akho manje:

rows: Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abaneminyaka engu-60 nangaphezulu abadlula esivivinyweni semali
Abantu abaneminyaka engu-18-59 abanokungqubazeka komzimba noma kwengqondo okuqinisekisiwe ngokuhlolwa kwezokugula kwesifunda
Abaphathi bokunakekela abakhulu bantfwana abangaphansi kweminyaka engu-18 abadlula esivivinyweni semali
Abazali ababekwe yicala abanakekela izingane ezibekwe esikhundleni sabo
Abanakekeli bantfwana abanokungqubazeka okukhulu okudinga ukunakekelwa isikhathi sonke
Abasokisi abadala beMpi Yomhlaba Wezwe Noma iMpi yaMakhoreya abaneminyaka engu-60+
Abamukeli be-grant abadinga ukunakekelwa isikhathi sonke
Abantu abangasebenzi abaneminyaka engu-18-60 abangenamali noma ukusekelwa (becela ku-inthanethi)
contentBlocks.caption: Izinhloko ezinkulu ze-SASSA grant namazinga okhokhelwa akhona manje

contentBlocks.text: Iyunithi ngayinye ye-grant kulibrari yethu ichaza imigomo yokufaneleka eqondile. Izibonelo ezimbili: awunakwamukela i-Older Persons Grant uma uthola imali ngaphezu kwesilinganiso, futhi awunakwamukela i-SRD R370 uma uthola i-UIF, ukusekela kwe-NSFAS, noma noma yini enye i-grant. Lapho kunokungenzeka ukuthi izingodo zimbili — ngokwesibonelo igogo eyanakekela izingane zangaphambili ingafaneleka ku-Child Support (njengomunakekeli) ne-Older Persons — ungalicela ngalinye ngokwalo uma uhlangabezana nemigomo yalo.

steps.title: Hlola ukufaneleka kwakho ngokuningiliziwe
steps.description: Funda izidingo ezithile zegrant yakho — iminyaka, amazinga emali, imithetho yokuhlala, nezidingo zokugula. Uhlu lwethu lwezinhloko ze-grant nokufaneleka lubalwa wonke.

steps.title: Qoqa yonke imibhalo yokuqala
steps.description: Qoqa imibhalo yokuqala nezindatshana zokuhlinzeka kwalokhu okubalwe ku-checklist engaphansi. Imibhalo embulala yiwona imbuyiselo enkulu kakhoku yokubuyela ekhontini nokubambezeleka.

steps.title: Vakashela ibhurokhokhi ye-SASSA esedu kunakho konke
steps.description: Ukucela izingodo zihlala kufanele kwenziwe ngokubuka. Fika kusenesikhathi — imijikelezo iyabubula ngaphambi kwesikhathi sokuvula. Akudingekisi isikhungo, kodwa ezinye izikhungo zinesistimu yokubhalisa ukuze kuhlolwe ukungqubazeka.

steps.title: Qedela isicelo nomhloli
steps.description: Umhloli we-SASSA ugcwala ifomu esemthethweni nawe. Ungayisayini ngaphambi kokuthi uqinisekise ukuthi konke kunembile. Izinwele zakho zizothathwa njengengxenye yokuqinisekisa ubunikazi.

steps.title: Yenza ukubhalisa (ngokwegranti ethile)
steps.description: Ukucela ukuNgqabazeka ne-Care Dependency kudinga ukuhlola kwezokugula kwesifunda. Umhloli uzobhala isikhungo sakho noma akuthumele ku-district surgeon. Ukuhlangana, ukwehlukanisa, nokuhlola imali kuhlolwa ku-database yabaphathi.

steps.title: Thola i-receipt yakho enesikhathi
steps.description: Uzothola i-receipt enenombolo yokubhekelela. Yithathele izithombe ufake iphepha livikeleke — uyayidinga lenombolo ukuze uhlolise isimo futhi ubekezele.

steps.title: Landela isicelo sakho
steps.description: Hlola inqubekela ngale ndlela ye-WhatsApp (082 046 8553), noma nge-inthanethi (0800 60 10 11), noma endaweni yakho usebenzisa inombolo yokubhekelela. Ukucubungula kuthatha kungakapheli izinyanga ezintathu.

steps.title: Thola isinqumo nasokhokhelwa kokuqala
steps.description: Uma imvume inikiwe, izinkokhelo zibuyiselwa esikhathini sesicelo sakho. Uma aliwe, uzothola izizathu ezibhalwe phansi futhi ukhulume ngokukhathazeka kungakapheli izinsuku eziyi-90.

items: Izikhungo ze-SASSA zendawo: wonke izingodo zihlala (Older Persons, Disability, Child Support, Foster Care, Care Dependency). Le ndlela eyodwa yalezi zingodo.
Ku-inthanethi ku-srd.sassa.gov.za: i-SRD R370 grant kuphela. Ukucela konke kuthatha imizuzu engu-10 futhi kudinga inombolo yakho ye-ID, imininingwane yokuxhumana, neze-banking.
WhatsApp 082 046 8553: ukucela i-SRD R370 nokubhekelela isimo.
Ukuhlola ekhaya: uma ungahambi ngenxa yesifo, cela ilungu lemndeni ukulungisa ukuhlola ekhaya ngokubhalisa endaweni yakho.

documents.label: I-ID yakho yokuqala ye-13-digit noma i-smart card ene-barcode yaseNingizimu Afrika
documents.notes: I-ID yesikhashana yamkelekile ngenkathi ulinde idokhumenti esemthethweni

documents.label: Isibonakaliso sokuhlala (ibhili lamanzi, i-affidavit, noma incwadi ye-council)
documents.notes: Uma uhlala endaweni engenamigqomo, incwadi yaqinisekisa ivela ku-ward councillor iyasebenza

documents.label: Izigigi zebhange zamasonto amathathu okugcina
documents.notes: Kudingekile uma unebhange; ikhombisa umhloli wezimali isimo sakho sangempela semali

documents.label: Isitifiketi sokushada (uma ushashile) noma umyalo wokwehlukanisa
Izifayela zokukhokha noma incwadi yabasebenzi (uma usebenza)
Ifomu ye-UI-19 evela ku-Department of Labour (uma ube usebenze ngaphambili)
Amarisidi okuzalwa kwantfwana (ukucela i-Child Support, Care Dependency)
Isibonakaliso sokuhamba esikoleni (izingane eziyi-7-18 ku-Child Support Grant)
documents.notes: Kudingeka kamuva; umunakekeli wentfwana kufanele aqinisekise ukubhalisa esikoleni minyaka yonke

documents.label: Umbiko wezokugula / incwadi yokuthumela (Disability, Care Dependency)
documents.notes: Ukuhlola kwesifunda kuqaliswa yi-SASSA, kodwa letha nanoma yiziphi izibonakaliso zokugula ezikhona

documents.label: Umyalo wecala obeka intfwana esikhundleni sakho (Foster Care)

contentBlocks.text: Iningi lezingodo zihlala liyagunyaziswa isivivinyo semali — ukuhlola imali yakho nezimpahla ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi udinga ngempela ukusekela. Imali yakho eyedwa, nokuthi uma ushashile, imali yabalingani zakho ihlanganiswe. Izimpahla ezifana nephrofethi nazo zihlolwa. Amazinga ajika minyaka ngayinye; uhlobo lwethu lokuqonda isivivinyo semali uhlaka amazinga akhona manje ngemibhalo esecacile.

contentBlocks.title: Sho Konke
contentBlocks.text: Ungafihli imali noma ama-akhawunti ebhange. I-SASSA iqinisekisa izitatimende ngokumelene nezinketho zebhange nezabasebenzi, futhi imali engasho etholwe kamuva iholela ekukhishweni nokubuyiselwa kokukhokhelwe. Ukuveza imali ngokungaxabani kungasalela ukufaneleka kwakho.

rows: Ifomu ligcwele, ubunikazi buthathwe, i-receipt inikwa inombolo yokubhekelela
UBunikazi, isimo sokushada, imali, nokuhlola i-database kuqediwe
Isikhungo nodokotela wesifunda; imiphumela ifakwa esinqumweni
Isicelo samukelwe noma saliwe nezizathu ezibhalwe phansi
contentBlocks.caption: Ugudu olujwayelekile lokucubungula isicelo se-grant

contentBlocks.text: Akukho lapho ukhokha khona noma yisiphi isigaba. Uma umuntu ekucela imali ukuze isicelo sisheshe — kuhlanganisa abakuti- agents ngaphandle kwezikhungo ze-SASSA — babika ku-fraud hotline ku-0800 601 011.

faqs.question: Ngingacela ku-inthanethi i-grant ye-SASSA?
faqs.answer: I-SRD R370 grant kuphela ekamukela ukucela okugcwele ku-inthanethi, ku-srd.sassa.gov.za. Wonke izingodo zihlala zidinga ukuvakashela endaweni ngoba ubunikazi nezincwadi zokuqala kufanele ziqinisekiswe.

faqs.question: Kubiza malini ukucela?
faqs.answer: Akukho lutho. Yonke inkonzo ye-SASSA iyamahhala. Bika noma ubani okucela imali yokucela, yokusheshisa, noma yamafomu ku-fraud line ku-0800 601 011.

faqs.question: Kuthatha isikhathi esingakanani ukuvunywa?
faqs.answer: Kungakapheli izinyanga ezintathu ngokomthetho. Izicelo ezilula zigcina zisinqunyelwe ngaphambi kwesikhathi; ezidinga ukuhlola kwezokugula zithatha isikhathi eside. Izinkokhelo zibuyiselwa esikhathini sesicelo sakho noma kukade kucatshangwa.

faqs.question: Ngingacela izingodo ezimbili ngesikhathi esisodwa?
faqs.answer: Yebo, uma ngempela uhlangabezana nemigomo ngayinye — ngokwesibonelo i-Older Persons Grant ne-Child Support Grant njengomunakekeli. Awunakwamukela izingodo ezixubanisa izimo ezifana ne-Disability ne-Older Persons ngasikhathi sinye.

faqs.question: Kwenzeka nini uma ngenayo idokhumenti ye-ID?
faqs.answer: Cela i-ID yesikhashana ku-Home Affairs kuqala — i-SASSA yamkela i-ID yesikhashana ekuceleni. Ukuhlola ekhaya kungalungiswa ngokubhalisa endaweni yakho.

faqs.question: Isicelo sami saliwe. Ngenzenjani?
faqs.answer: Funda isizathu sokwaliwa esikwigama lesaziso, bese ubeka ukukhathazeka kungakapheli izinsuku eziyi-90. Iningi lokwaliwa libuyiselwa uma kuthunyelwe amadokhumenti afanele.

faqs.question: Ngabe umuntu ongacela esikhundleni sami?
faqs.answer: Yebo. Umuntu oqinisekisiwe (proxy) angacela ezinye izingodo esikhundleni sakho ngencwadi yemvume nama-ID womabili. Nge-SRD grant, ukucela kufanele kwenziwe nge-ID noma inombolo yocingo yakho.

faqs.question: Nini lapho kufanele ngicela kabusha noma ngivuselele?
faqs.answer: Izingodo zihlala ziqhubeka ngaphandle kokuvuselela kodwa zihlolwa ngesikhathi. I-Foster Care Grant iphela ngomyla ngamunye wecala futhi kufanele ivuselelwe ngaphambi kokuphela. I-SRD grant iphinde ihlolwe nyanga ngayinye ngokuzenzakalelayo.
